agentContributions.notes: Classified as defect: Live Preview configuration already exists in src/services/contentstack.ts (lines 58–85) with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_ENABLE, management_token, and host, but the feature is not functional across GO/UP/MX — existing behavior is incomplete/broken. The useContent hook (236 callers) is the sole conduit for content delivery; any Live Preview data flow must pass through it. Addressed flag 1 by grounding every criterion in the actual code shown (options object, useContent, consuming components). Addressed flag 3 by producing acceptance criteria from the description. Addressed flag 2 by anchoring to real code paths rather than assumed patterns. All VCs stop at the Contentstack API boundary.

coordinatorReview.reviewNotes: Both agents added non-overlapping value: openspec provided architectural scoping (useContent as the 236-caller attachment point, Contentstack API boundary constraint) and speckit drafted acceptance criteria from that foundation. However, openspec produced zero acceptance criteria despite being the elaboration agent, and speckit explicitly could not read source files — all ACs are built on assumed standard Contentstack Live Preview patterns rather than code analysis. Speckit self-flagged that AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, and AC-8 may need adjustment if the implementation mechanism differs. As a brownfield defect ticket with immutable empty ACs, the absence of ACs from openspec is less severe than it appears, but the collaborative output still requires human verification against the actual codebase before it can be trusted for implementation.
